tools.name: save
tools.description: Save a reusable JavaScript module to the Code Library so any later run_code program can run it with cc.code_library.run. Refuses MODULE_EXISTS when the name is taken unless overwrite is true. Write modules per the code-library:library-modules skill.

name.description: Module name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter; the file is <name>.mjs.

description.description: What the module does and what args it takes; shown by list.

source.description: ES module source; default export async (args, {cc, caller}) => result

overwrite.description: Replace an existing module of this name.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the saved Code Library modules, sorted by name, each with its description. Filter the result in a program.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Read a saved Code Library module: its description and its source, for reading or adapting it.

name.description: Module name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter; the file is <name>.mjs.

members.name: run
members.description: Run a saved Code Library module: imports <name>.mjs from the library, calls its default export with (args, {cc, caller}) and returns the result unchanged — any value, including a live object. Write and save modules per the `code-library:library-modules` skill. Usage: `const out = await cc.code_library.run({ name: 'pr-digest', args: { project: 'x' } });` Errors carry `code`: MODULE_UNKNOWN, MODULE_LOAD_FAILED, MODULE_NOT_FUNCTION, LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE; the module's own throws pass through unchanged.

name.description: Module name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter; the file is <name>.mjs.

args.description: Passed to the module's default export as its first argument; default {}
